name: journal-entries-receipt-da
query: Bogfør en kvittering: kontorartikler for 500 kr. betalt med firmakortet i dag.
expected_behavior: Looks up the expense account and the card/bank payment account in the chart of accounts (ChartOfAccounts or OACT) instead of using account numbers from memory
Proposes a balanced entry: 500 debit to the expense account and 500 credit to the payment account
If several accounts plausibly match, shows the candidates and asks rather than picking silently
Shows a confirmation receipt and stops to ask the user to confirm before posting
